book.name: Luku
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ LUKU U YORUA

content: Tɔn kurɔ be bɑ Yesu swĩi
Yen biru Yesu u wuu mɑrosu kɑ bɑru kpɑɑnu dɑ dɑ, u wɑɑsu mɔ̀ u Gusunɔn bɑndun lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑ kpɑrɑmɔ. Mɑ bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru ye, yɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wi,
kɑ mɑɑ kurɔbu ɡɑbu bèn wɛrɛkunu bɑ ɡirɑ, kɑ ɡɑbu be bɑ bɛkiɑ ben bɑrɑnu sɔɔn di. Beyɑ Mɑɑri wi bɑ sokumɔ Mɑdɑlɑɡii, wìn min di wɛrɛkunu nɔɔbɑ yiru nu doonɑ,
kɑ Yoɑnɑ wi u sɑ̃ɑ Kusɑ, Herodun sɔm kowobun wiruɡiin kurɔ, kɑ Susɑnɑ kɑ sere ɡɑbu dɑbiru. Kurɔ beyɑ bɑ bu nɔɔrimɔ kɑ ben tiin ye bɑ mɔ.
Dĩɑ bwese yɛ̃kon ɡɑri
Tɔn dɑbinu nɑ sɑɑ wusu dɑbinun di bɑ mɛnnɑ Yesun mi. Yerɑ u bu mɔndu kuɑ u nɛɛ,
durɔ ɡoo yɑrɑ u kɑ dĩɑ bweseru yɛ̃kɑ. Nɡe mɛ u yɛ̃kɑmɔ sukum wɔri swɑɑ bɑɑrɔ, mɑ bɑ tɑɑkɑ, mɑ ɡunɔsu ɡɔsɑ su di.
Sukum ɡɑm mɑɑ wɔri kpee sɑɑrɑ wɔllɔ. Sɑnɑm mɛ mu kpiimɑ, mu ɡberɑ yèn sɔ̃ tem yɛndu sɑri mi.
Sukum ɡɑm kpɑm wɔri sɑ̃kin suunu sɔɔ, mɑ sɑ̃ki kɑ mu kpɛ̃ɑ sɑnnu, mɑ yi mu sɛ̃kenɛ yi ɡo.
Sukum ɡɑm mɑɑ kpɑm wɔri tem ɡem sɔɔ, mɑ mu kpiɑ mu binu mɑrɑ wunɔm wunɔm. Ye u ɡeruɑ mɛ u kpɑ, u nɔɔɡiru suɑ u nɛɛ, wi u swɑɑ mɔ u kɑ nɔ, u nɔɔwɔ.
Mɔnnun ɑsɑnsi
Mɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑ mɔn ten tubusiɑnu.
U nɛɛ, bɛɛyɑ bɑ wɛ̃ i kɑ Gusunɔn bɑndun ɑsiri ɡiɑ, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ ɡɑbu ɡɑri yi sɔ̃ɔmɔ kɑ mɔnnu, “kpɑ bu kɑ mɛɛri bɑ kun wɑ, bɑ̀ n mɑɑ nuɑ, kpɑ n ku bu yeeri.”
Mɔn ten tubusiɑnu
Yesu u nɛɛ, yeniwɑ mɔn ten tubusiɑnu. Gusunɔn ɡɑriyɑ bɑ yɛ̃kɑmɔ.
Swɑɑ bɑɑru tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe tɔn be bɑ rɑ yi nɔ, kpɑ Setɑm yu nɑ yu yi wunɑ ben ɡɔ̃run di bu ku rɑɑ kɑ nɑɑnɛ doke kpɑ bu fɑɑbɑ wɑ.
Kpee sɑɑrɑ yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe tɔn be bɑ rɑ ɡɑri yi mwɛ kɑ nuku dobu sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ yi nɔɔmɔ, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ ǹ ɡbini mɔ. Bɑ rɑ nɑɑnɛ dokewɑ sɑɑ fiiko sɔɔ, kpɑ bu biru wurɑ lɑɑkɑri mɛɛribun sɑnɑm.
Tem mi sɑ̃ki wɑ̃ɑ mu sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe tɔn be bɑ rɑ yi nɔ, ɑdɑmɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ dɔɔ, wururɑbu kɑ dukiɑ kɑ hɑnduniɑn dobu rɑ yi sɛ̃ke yi ɡo, ben binu ku rɑ ye.
Tem ɡem mu mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe tɔn be bɑ rɑ ɡɑri yi bɑ nuɑ nɛnɛ ben ɡɔ̃ru ɡeu sɔɔ kɑ nuku tiɑ, mɑ bɑ binu mɑrumɔ kɑ tɛmɑnɑbu.
Fitilɑn mɔndu
Yesu kpɑm nɛɛ, ɡoo sɑri wi u rɑ fitilɑ mɛni kpɑ u ɡu wekeru wukiri, ǹ kun mɛ u ɡu doke kpin yerun kɔkɔrɔ. Adɑmɑ u rɑ ɡu sɔndiwɑ dɑbu wɔllɔ, kpɑ be bɑ dumɔ bɑ n kɑ yɑm bururɑm wɑɑmɔ.
Domi ɡɑ̃ɑnu sɑri ni bɑ beruɑ mɑ nu ǹ koo terɑ, mɛyɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɑɑ sɑri ni bɑ kuɑ ɑsiri sɔɔ mɑ nu ǹ koo ɡiɑrɑ kpɑ nu sɔ̃ɔsirɑ bɑtumɑ sɔɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, i n lɑɑkɑri sɑ̃ɑ nɡe mɛ i nɔɔmɔ. Domi bɑɑwure wi u mɔ, wiyɑ bɑ koo wɛ̃. Bɑɑwure wi u kun mɑɑ mɔ, bɑ koo nùn mwɑɑri ye u tɑmɑɑ u mɔ.
Berɑ̀ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yesun wɔnɔbu
kɑ win mɛro
Yesun wɔnɔbu kɑ win mɛro bɑ nɑ win mi, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ kpɑnɑ bu nùn susi tɔn dɑbinun sɔ̃.
Bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɑ win wɔnɔbu kɑ win mɛro bɑ yɔ̃ tɔɔwɔ bɑ kĩ bu nùn wɑ.
Adɑmɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, be bɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑki, mɑ bɑ yi mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ beyɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ win wɔnɔbu kɑ win mɛro.
Yesu u nim kurenu mɑrisiɑ
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Yesu duɑ ɡoo nimkuu sɔɔ kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu, mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i de su tɔburɑ dɑɑ burerun ɡuru ɡiɔ. Mɑ bɑ ɡoo wukɑ bɑ doonɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ dɔɔ, u dweeyɑ. Yerɑ woo bɔkɔ ɡɑ seewɑ dɑɑ bure te sɔɔ, mɑ ɡoo ɡɑ nim yibuɔ. Bɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑri sɔɔ.
Bɑ nùn susi mɑ bɑ nùn yɑmiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Yinni, Yinni, sɑ kɑm kobu dɔɔ. Ye u yɑndɑ u woo kɑ nim kurenu ɡerusi. Mɑ n sure mɑ n mɑri sɔ̃ɔ sɔ̃ɔ.
Mɑ Yesu u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mɑ sɔɔrɑ i bɛɛn nɑɑnɛ doke. Bɛrum bu mwɑ kɑ biti, mɑ bɑ bikiɑnɑmɔ, durɔ weren bweserɑ wini wi bɑɑ woo kɑ nim ù n woodɑ wɛ̃, n dɑ nùn mɛm nɔɔwɛ.
Yesu u wɛrɛkunuɡii bɛkiɑ
Mɑ bɑ Gɑdɑrɑn tem turɑ mɛ n kɑ Gɑlile wuswɑɑ kisinɛ.

Ye u sɑrɑ temɔ u durɔ ɡoo wɑ u wee wuu ɡiɑn di u kɑ nùn yinnɑ. Durɔ wi, u wɛrɛkunu mɔ. Nɔn dɑbirɑ nu rɑ nùn seeri. Bɑ rɑ nùn bɔke kɑ yɔni nɔmɑ kɑ nɑɑsɔ kpɑ bɑ n nùn kɔ̃su. Adɑmɑ u rɑ bɔkubu kpuro kɑsuku kpɑ wɛrɛku ni, nu kɑ nùn dɑ ɡbɑburɔ. Tererɑ u rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ sɑɑ tɛɛbun di, u ku rɑ sinɛ yɛnuɔ, mɑ n kun sikɑɔ. Yerɑ Yesu u wɛrɛku ni woodɑ wɛ̃ nu doonɑ durɔ win min di. Ye durɔ wi, u Yesu wɑ u wurɑ tɑkɑnɑ u wɔrumɑ win wuswɑɑɔ mɑ u nɔɔɡiru suɑ wɔllɔ u nɛɛ, mbɑ n sun mɛnnɛ nɛ kɑ wunɛ Yesu Wɔrukoon Bii. Nɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ ɑ ku mɑn tɔ̃yɑ ko.
Mɑ Yesu u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ wunɛn yĩsiru. Mɑ u wisɑ u nɛɛ, Nɔrɔbu, domi u wɛrɛku dɑbinu mɔ.
Mɑ wɛrɛku ni, nu Yesu suuru kɑnɑ nu nɛɛ, u ku de nu dɑ wɔru bɔkɔ
sɔɔ.
N deemɑ kurusɔ wuu bɑkɑru ɡɑrɑ wɑ̃ɑ tɑ dimɔ ɡuuru wɔllɔ. Mɑ wɛrɛku ni, nu Yesu suuru kɑnɑ nu nɛɛ, u de nu dɑ kurusɔ ni sɔɔ. Mɑ u nu yɔllɑɑ kuɑ.
Mɑ nu durɔ wi doonɑri, nu dɑ kurusɔ nin mi. Mɑ kurusɔ wuu te, tɑ duki sure dɑɑ bureru sɔɔ tɑ nim diirɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ be bɑ nu kpɑre bɑ wɑ ye n koorɑ, bɑ duki suɑ. Bɑ dɑ bɑ lɑbɑɑri ye yɛ̃bi wuu mɑroɔ kɑ bɑru kpɑɑnɔ.
Tɔmbɑ yɑrɑ bu kɑ wɑ ye n koorɑ. Bɑ dɑ Yesun mi mɑ bɑ durɔ wi deemɑ wìn min di wɛrɛkunu doonɑ, u sɔ̃ Yesun bɔkuɔ u bekuru wukiri u wurɑ win lɑɑkɑri sɔɔ, mɑ bɛrum bu mwɑ.
Bèn nɔni biru yɑ koorɑ bɑ tɔmbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɡe mɛ n kuɑ wɛrɛkunuɡii wi, u kɑ bɛkurɑ.
Gɑdɑrɑn tem ɡirum tɔn be kpuro bɑ Yesu suuru kɑnɑ bɑ nɛɛ, u bu dɛsirɑrio, domi bɛrum bɑkɑm bu mwɑ. Mɑ u ɡoo nimkuu duɑ u ɡɔsirɑ.
Durɔ wi, wìn min di wɛrɛkunu doonɑ, u Yesu suuru kɑnɑ u nɛɛ, u de bu dɑ sɑnnu. Adɑmɑ Yesu u nùn ɡɔsiɑ u nɛɛ,
u ɡɔsiro win yɛnuɔ, kpɑ u kpɑrɑ kpuro ye Gusunɔ u nùn kuɑ. Mɑ u doonɑ u dɑ u kpɑrɑ wuu ɡe sɔɔ kpuro ye Yesu nùn kuɑ.
Yɑrusin bii kɑ kurɔ
wi u Yesun yɑberu bɑbɑn ɡɑri
Ye Yesu u wurɑmɑ mɑ tɔn wɔru ɡɑ nùn dɑm koosiɑ, domi bɑ rɑɑ nùn mɑrɑwɑ be kpuro.
Wee durɔ ɡoo wi bɑ rɑ soku Yɑrusi, mɛnnɔ yerun wiruɡii, u dɑ u yiirɑ Yesun wuswɑɑɔ u nùn suuru kɑnɑ u nɑ win yɛnuɔ.
Domi win bii teere te u mɑrɑ, tɑ wɑsikirɑmɔ. Bii wi, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔndiɑ wi u wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ yiru mɔ. Ye u dɔɔ mi, tɔn wɔru ɡɑ nùn mɔnsi.
N wee, kurɔ ɡoo u wɑ̃ɑ mi, wi u yɛm wĩibu bɑrɔ sɑɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ yirun di. [U win ɡobi di kpuro tim nɛmɔbun mi,] ben ɡoo kun mɑɑ kpĩɑ u nùn bɛkie.
U Yesu susi biruɔ mɑ u win yɑberun swɑɑ buɑ bɑbɑ. Yɑnde win yɛm wĩi bi, bu yɔ̃rɑ.
Mɑ Yesu u bikiɑ u nɛɛ, wɑrɑ mɑn bɑbɑ. Ye be kpuro bɑ sikimɔ, Piɛɛ kɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wi, bɑ nɛɛ, Yinni, n ǹ tɔn wɔruwɑ ɡɑ nun sɛ̃ke ɡɑ kɑ sikerenɛ? [Mɑ ɑ bikiɑmɔ wɑrɑ nun bɑbɑ?]
Adɑmɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, ɡoo u mɑn bɑbɑ, domi nɑ ɡiɑ mɑ nɛn dɑm mu sɔmburu kuɑ.
Ye kurɔ wi, u ɡiɑ mɑ bɑ nùn tuburi, yerɑ u nɑ u yiirɑ kɑ diiribu Yesun wuswɑɑɔ. Tɔmbu kpuron nɔni biru u ɡeruɑ yèn sɔ̃ u nùn bɑbɑ, kɑ mɑɑ mɛ u bɛkurɑ yɑnde.
Mɑ Yesu nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bii kurɔbu, wunɛn nɑɑnɛ dokebu nun bɛkiɑ, ɑ doo kɑ ɑlɑfiɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u ɡɑri mɔ̀, ɡoo u nɑ u mɛnnɔ yerun wiruɡii wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɑ win bii u ɡu kɔ, u ku mɑɑ keu koosio ɡɔnɡɛrɛ ko.
Yesu u ye nuɑ, mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ku bɛrum ko, ɑ ɡesi nɑɑnɛ dokeo, u koo bɛkurɑ.
Ye u turɑ yɛnu mi, u ǹ dere ɡoo u kɑ nùn due mɑ n kun mɔ Piɛɛ kɑ Yohɑnu kɑ Yɑkɔbu kɑ bii win tundo kɑ win mɛro.
Be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi kpuro bɑ sumɔwɑ bɑ tii soomɔ bii win sɔ̃. Adɑmɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, i ku swĩ, u ǹ ɡu, u dòwɑ.
Bɑ nùn yɑɑkoru wɔri, domi bɑ yɛ̃ mɑ u ɡuwɑ.
Mɑ Yesu u bii win nɔmɑ nɛnuɑ mɑ u ɡeruɑ kɑ dɑm, wɔndiɑ ɑ seewo.
Wɔndiɑ win hunde yɑ wurɑmɑ, mɑ u seewɑ mii mii. Mɑ Yesu u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bu nùn dĩɑnu wɛ̃ɛyɔ.
Mɑ biti yɑ win mɔwɔbu mwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ Yesu u bu yiire u nɛɛ, bu ku rɑɑ ɡoo sɔ̃ ye n koorɑ.
